name: product-rebuild
description: Gated, agent-orchestrated pipeline for rebuilding an existing product end to end.

plugins.name: product-rebuild
plugins.description: Rebuild an existing product end-to-end to learn the full product development lifecycle. A gated, agent-orchestrated pipeline: mine a reference product, build a feature matrix, slice milestones, decide architecture via mirror-or-diverge ADRs, lock contracts, build in parallel per slice, and finish at a verified production-readiness gate.
